title: Use the discriminant to determine the number of roots

source_reference.notes: Original Edexcel 4MA1 Higher-style item for the Year 10 quadratics MVP. Edexcel pivot metadata applied.

problem_text: For x^2 - 4x + 7 = 0, find the value of the discriminant and state the number of real roots.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: The calculated discriminant is negative, so the interpretation should follow the negative case.
A negative discriminant means there are no real roots.

hint_ladder.title: What does the discriminant decide?
hint_ladder.prompt: The discriminant tells you about the number of real roots without solving the whole equation.

hint_ladder.title: Pick a starting move
hint_ladder.prompt: Identify a, b, and c, then calculate b^2 - 4ac carefully.

hint_ladder.title: A common slip
hint_ladder.prompt: Many students calculate a discriminant but do not interpret its sign. The sign is the point of the question.

hint_ladder.title: The general pattern
hint_ladder.prompt: After calculating b^2 - 4ac, use only its sign to decide the root case. Apply the sign test to your calculated value.

common_errors: does not connect the calculated sign to the root case
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: The stuck point is using the sign of the discriminant for the root case.

expected_solution_steps.expression: negative discriminant means no real roots
common_errors: does not connect sign to roots
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: The stuck point is interpreting what a negative discriminant means.

mark_scheme_notes: Award marks for correct discriminant calculation and correct interpretation.
examiner_report_notes: Likely errors: arithmetic sign mistakes and weak interpretation of discriminant sign.
metacognition_prompt: Before you start, what does the discriminant tell you?
